1.consolidated_definition: Fruto del jobo, de forma redondeada, carnoso, de color amarillo o rojo al madurar, y de una sola semilla; es comestible.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fruit of the jobo tree, rounded in shape, fleshy, yellow or red when ripe, and containing a single seed; edible.
